svg.aria-label: How TabAgent works. Training, once per agent and catalog: the agent's successful runs go to TabSchema, which discovers features (LLM agents analyze, write code and judge), then TabSynth, which adds label-preserving paraphrases, then TabHead, a CatBoost classifier that scores every candidate and returns the decision. Inference, every decision: instead of a frontier-LLM call (GPT-5.4 shortlister, 7.50 s and $0.052 per decision), one TabHead pass takes 2.682 ms and $2.0×10⁻⁷; unsure decisions can defer back to the LLM.
